task.title: Shared Briefing Intelligence layer: Weekly Sep 20-26 diagnosis + design proposal (checkpoint)

result.summary: Diagnosis complete and design proposed; implementation not started. Root causes: Weekly V3 keeps one aggregate observation per domain (daily distribution/runs/routine lost), narrative excludes nutrition/activity from hero/Coach's Take and falls to fixed no-change templates under continue_current_strategy, confidence explanation names the top exercise-level coaching candidate (Bicep tie at 133.7, some pre-window), Native renders surfaced:false uncertainty via a materiality==high override. Canonical data does NOT show higher Thu-Sat intake (Thu-Sat mean 2417 vs baseline 2585); it DOES show a late-week multi-domain routine break (no strength Fri/Sat, movement ~halved, no weigh-ins, Fri protein 72 g probable under-log). Proposed: a shared, deterministic Briefing Intelligence layer (briefing_intelligence_v1) on the single V3 prepare path used by all five briefing types, reading canonical daily authorities, with shared baselines/detectors/materiality/restraint, and per-type policies; byte-identical output when absent.

production_verification.summary: Two bounded REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY reads, rolled back, success-marker gated at production SHA 49211870; app logs cross-checked.

decisions_required: Approve the shared Briefing Intelligence abstraction and phasing (Weekly policy first; then Midweek/Monthly consolidation; then DEXA/Photo).
Accept re-scoped acceptance case 2: do not claim higher Thu-Sat intake (not in canonical data); surface the evidenced late-week disruption and flag nutrition logging reliability.
Approve a separate lane for ingestion defects (HealthKit duplicate day totals, partial-day tiering, quarantined HealthKit nutrition feeding the Energy card).
unexpected_findings: Founder-recalled Thu-Sat intake increase is absent from canonical data; Fri 25 (72 g protein) looks under-logged yet is tiered full_day_asserted/high reliability.
Tue 22 nutrition totals are a byte-exact copy of Mon 21 (probable HealthKit day-attribution defect).
A larger Sep 3-6 high-intake/training-gap episode was never surfaced by any briefing.
Pattern/deviation reasoning is implemented three different ways (Energy variability, Monthly records, Monthly frequency) and ranking at least five ways.
backlog: Native: drop BriefingReadModel materiality==high uncertainty override / honor Server bounded Weekly uncertainty; batch with queued Log-tab Workout Logger item.
recommended_next_step: Founder approves (or amends) the three decisions; then implement Phase 1 on codex/weekly-v3-weekly-pattern-narrative with synthetic-period property validation and fresh-context review, targeting the Oct 4 Weekly.
